Frequently Asked Questions

Who is Sistah-Friends for?

Women of color who want genuine friendship, shared experiences, fun, community and new reasons to get out and enjoy life.

Do I have to come with someone?

No. Coming alone is welcome. The point is to help women build connections.

Can I bring a friend?

Yes. Bringing a friend is an important part of how the community grows.

Who hosts Sistah-Friends?

Sistah-Friends is a program hosted by Designer Destinations & Events, which supports event planning, group travel and experience coordination.
